'''Chedgar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] within the [[New Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Corps]]. With his career in jeopardy, Chedgar agreed to try out for the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]/[[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] that [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] was putting together. Chedgar was eliminated from the roster during the initial training and culling process that the candidates went through.<ref name="wraith" />

[[Kell Tainer]], another one of the candidates for the new squadron, believed that Chedgar was a victim of his own paranoia of officer conspiracies against him.<ref name="wraith" />
